name: CANOPY BY HILTON SIOUX FALLS DOWNTOWN

violations.description: HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): A hand drying device was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the catering kitchen near the combi ovens. Soap was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the catering kitchen near the soup kettle.
CONTAMINATION BY EMPLOYEES (3 pts): Observed employee with soiled golves continued to handle clean food containers and work in food prep areas.
DISHWASHING FACILITIES (2 pts): Sanitizer test kit noted not provided in the Cascada kitchen for lactic acid sanitizer.
CONTAMINATION FROM WIPING CLOTHS (2 pts): Wiping cloths in the catering kitchen noted not stored in adequate sanitizing solution.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Hot water pitchers in the catering utensil storage area is not completely dry. Meat slicer in the Cascada kitchen has debris build up on the product pusher.
PREMISES (1 pts): Mops and brooms not hung in the Cascada kitchen.

SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): The temperature of the rinse cycle of the heat sanitizing dish machine noted not adequate to achieve final sanitization. The banquet kitchen dish machine is not achieving proper sanitizing temperatures. When tested observed the highest temperature to reach 146.4?F.
POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of cut vegetable sauces and ingredients was noted not being properly dated for disposition.

SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): The temperature of the rinse cycle of the heat sanitizing dish machine noted not adequate to achieve final sanitization. The banquet kitchen dish machine is not achieving proper sanitizing temperatures.

STORAGE/HANDLING CLEAN EQUIP & UTENSILS (1 pts): Clean utensils noted stored in an unprotected location. Observed bins storing clean utensils in the Cascata kitchen has debris build up. Clean coffee pot and cream pitchers noted not being stored in a self draining position to allow for air drying. Observed residual water remaining in vessel after being washed.
